name: lumen-launcher
description: Couch-friendly launcher for Steam and EmuStart (emulated) games
author: Carlos

scripts.dist: npm run build:engine && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:engine && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:engine: cd engine && py -3 -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --log-level WARN lumen-engine.spec
scripts.test:engine: cd engine && py -3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests
